title: Oklahoma Beats Oklahoma State 41-13 on November 21, 2020
question: What was the score of the Oklahoma vs. Oklahoma State Bedlam game on November 21, 2020?
answer: On November 21, 2020, No. 18 Oklahoma beat No. 14 Oklahoma State 41-13 in Norman. Spencer Rattler threw for 301 yards and four touchdowns and ran for another score.
summary: On this date in 2020, No. 18 Oklahoma topped No. 14 Oklahoma State 41-13 in Norman, a sixth straight Bedlam win led by Spencer Rattler.
body: On this date in 2020, Bedlam came to Gaylord Family-Oklahoma Memorial Stadium on a Saturday night with both teams ranked. No. 18 Oklahoma hosted No. 14 Oklahoma State and left with a 41-13 win.

The Sooners came out fast. Spencer Rattler ran for a 9-yard touchdown and threw scoring passes to Mikey Henderson and Theo Wease, and Oklahoma led 21-0 inside the first nine minutes. Oklahoma State answered late in the quarter to make it 21-7, and the Sooners led 27-13 at halftime after field goals by Gabe Brkic and Oklahoma State's Brady Pohl.

Oklahoma added two more touchdowns in the fourth quarter to close it out. Rattler finished 17 of 24 for 301 yards, four touchdowns and no interceptions. Rhamondre Stevenson carried 26 times for a career-high 141 yards, and Wease caught two touchdown passes. Oklahoma out-gained the Cowboys 492 yards to 246.

The 21 first-quarter points were the most Oklahoma had scored in a first quarter against Oklahoma State in Norman, according to game coverage. It was also the Sooners' sixth straight win in the series and their 23rd consecutive November victory, a streak dating to 2014. Because of COVID-19 rules, the crowd was limited to about 25 percent of stadium capacity.
